units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23">Ex. R. s. 23</cite> <he>אין להן ת׳</he> cannot be washed; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:5:4">Cant. R. to I, 5</cite>, a.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982">Yalk. ib. 982</cite> <he>אין צריכין ת׳</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:11">Cant. R. to IV, 11</cite>; Pesik. B’shall., p. 92ᵃ, a. e. <he>ולא היו צריכין ת׳</he> but did they (their garments in the desert) not need washing? <cite ref="Moed Katan 15a">M. Kat. 15ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אבל אסור בת׳</he> a mourner is forbidden to wash his clothes.
<cite ref="Chullin 31b">Ḥull. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ ראשונה</he> washing the first time (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:54">Lev. XIII, 54</cite>), <he>ת׳ שניה</he> washing a second time (ib. 58); a. fr.
